committee.sub: Morning brief · Thursday 8 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Ad spend rose to A$148.43 across 24 clicks last 7 days (prior A$116.33 on 19 clicks), with cost per click at A$6.18 matching the test's expected rate, but conversions last7 sit at zero.

The landing-page test has logged 7 raw paid clicks and A$48.25 of ex-GST spend since 6 Oct, with one raw ask_cta_click and zero review_cta_click; these are raw counts only, Chris still needs to grade them against the qualified rule in the test log.

/free-workflow-review.html has taken 15 sessions since launch and sits inside the first review window (clicks 1 to 25), so headline and CTA changes are still allowed if the search-term and Clarity review on the next 3 clicks flags anything.

Form starts last7 were 3 against 0 completed generate_lead events, so interest is not converting to even an unverified enquiry this week; the one genuine enquiry on record remains the 23 Sept wholesale food contact.

AI Assistant sessions doubled to 4 last7 (prior 2), led by claude-check, while Organic Search climbed to 17 sessions from 6, the more trustworthy unpaid signal; Search Console data only runs through 4 Oct so it is lagging behind yesterday (Wed 7).

actions.text: Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) are still outstanding, sort these when time allows.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still quote 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; update these to match current site stats.
